notes.title: Bugfix Update #3
notes.content:
We received several reports of typos from our wonderful fans and testers. Today's patch should remedy most of them. Thank you for all of your feedback!
- Fixed a typo in Cyltan's dialog in Chapter 9, a typo in Hilda's dialog in Chapter 13
- Fixed a typo in Hilda's dialog for when a certain character dies
- Fixed a typo in Sheela's dialog in Chapter 3, and a typo in the opening narration dialog.

notes.title: Bugfix Update #2
notes.content:
We hope you're still enjoying the world of Vestaria Saga. Today we released a small patch to address a few more bugs/issues.

1. Orison and Mettle skill descriptions fixed.
2. Empyrean Wings item wielder list fixed.
3. Various typos fixed.
4. Untranslated dialog line fixed.

notes.title: Bugfix Update #1
notes.content:
We hope you're all enjoying the world of Vestaria Saga. Today we released a small patch to address issues that were brought to our attention. Thank you all for your patience and support, and please don't hesitate to let us know if you find something else.

- Green background at the end of the Grand Opening has been removed.
- 'Cutlass' dialog text error in the Prologue has been fixed.
- Fire Breath I description has been fixed.
- Typo in Zurne's dialog in Chapter 2 has been fixed.
